name: SignalStore sqlite
sensitivity: Telegram-derived signal payloads, routing metadata, and trading intent context
backup_method: Use sqlite online backup or stop dependent containers, copy /data/signal_store.db from the signal-data volume, encrypt the artifact, and record a sha256 checksum.

name: Importer audit log
sensitivity: Importer dispatch history, chat identifiers, message identifiers, and failure states
backup_method: Copy the append-only JSONL file from the signal-data volume with timestamped rotation, encrypt the artifact, and record line count plus sha256 checksum.

name: Freqtrade databases
sensitivity: Dry-run and live trade history, orders, positions, balances, and exchange-derived metadata
backup_method: Back up each sqlite database with sqlite online backup or a stopped-container copy, keep dry-run and live files separated, encrypt artifacts, and verify integrity with sqlite PRAGMA quick_check.

name: Freqtrade user_data state
sensitivity: Freqtrade configs, strategy code, pairlists, runtime state, and potential references to live execution settings
backup_method: Create a filtered archive of user_data excluding transient caches, encrypt it, record file manifest plus sha256 checksums, and store alongside the matching database backup.
